guard: Own-connection issued public caller discovery reaches real permitted read and write calls without using legacy or another connection caller.
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm smoke:endpoint-issued-public-caller
why: The genuine public CotalEndpoint entry reads its own accepted row and performs pinned describe/invoke under receipt binding. No copied low-level service or private cache is used.

The mutant restores the legacy serviceCaller decision while leaving the explicit issued option and own discovery in place. The named actual public-write acceptance cell must turn red before any write effect.

Baseline, mutant and afterRestore build the actual core/auth exports and run the complete53-cell entry. Restoration is not only a build. A full endpoint implementation reversion can also compile this fixture because the additive option objects are ordinary structural spreads, not type assertions or compiler suppression.
